[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Gerrin Nikals''' was the commanding officer of the [[special missions platoon]] [[Kal'Shebbol's Fury]], a soldier unit of the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during his campaign.
